lines.speaker: pell
lines.text: You're the one from the monastery. The Auditor. I'm Pell. I keep the gate — kept it, anyway, before the drone started coming.

lines.speaker: pell
lines.text: Every night it circles a bit lower than the night before. That's not weather and it's not a fault, that's an allocation pattern. It's counting us, and when a thing has counted you long enough it starts deciding about you.

lines.speaker: pell
lines.text: The day it decides we want managing is the day this stops being a free town and starts being a line on a schedule. Go up and break it. I've a prayer wheel from the founding year, proper old, a trader would want it. Yours if you do.
